finding.text: At 3440 the grid stretches: Name takes 1fr and Cost sits far right, so the Name→Cost gap is huge and the page is 77% empty (layout.json empty 0.768, ink 0.229) — shots/.../3440.png, table band. Cap the Name column or the grid's max width (layout 5).

At 400 the table is wider than the screen (widest_text 443 vs 400 wide, wide grid with 8 columns, min widths sum >400) so Cost/Updated sit off-screen or need sideways scroll; the first thing a phone reader needs (name + cost) should fit — shots/.../400.png, bottom band; the owner flagged mobile as already slow.

This diff shows only page edits (page.js, SessionView.js, sessions.css). Deliverables 1, 2, 4, 5 (findings.md, Session.js + node test, Server/session-summary.mjs, doc note) and the before/after bytes-and-requests measurement (ask 4) are not in the diff, so they could not be checked; confirm they landed in the same branch.

The default sort now weights cost by recency (halves every 3 days). It is a ranking the owner did not ask for in the brief and is not named anywhere on the page — say so in a title on the Cost header or in doc/.
The "updated HH:MM" header text replaces "live — polls every 20s" but polling still happens (poll loop remains); the page is a poll, not the stream the brief says to use (live-not-polling).
Page-shell rail buttons wrap to 3.2 lines at 400 (layout.json wraps drawer-rail-ai/menu) — not caused by this diff, left as is.
Four stat tiles and a chip row sit above the table; at 1200 the table starts roughly mid-screen. Fine, but the cost-breakdown link text is small — shots/.../1200.png, band 2.
